options_dna_relationship: none for VERY_HIGH; the CALL/14 CONFIRMATION_FAILURE finding is HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_FINDING_NEEDS_EXTERNAL_REPLICATION and is explicitly excluded from eligibility
position_management_relationship: BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_REPLAY_COVERAGE; any open-position policy below is EXPERIMENTAL_HEURISTIC

underlying_dna.named_timeframe_agreement: confirmation (60/120) and timing (15/30) tiers share tone
underlying_dna.no_disqualifying_conflict: no FAIL/FAIL TEST on Direction, Campaign, or Confirmation tiers

contract_response.active_print_required: non-zero causal contract option_return at the decision bar

execution_quality.price_reference: latest recorded bar close (no bid/ask, no midpoint, no real-time quote)

fill_model.price_reference: latest available option aggregate bar close at revalidation time
fill_model.conservative_declared: delayed bar-close fill; no bid/ask, no midpoint, no spread, no fee, no slippage
fill_model.roll_fill: two legs each require their own price reference; otherwise UNSCORABLE_EXECUTION_DATA

vetoes.sec_catalyst: independent veto or policy modifier, never folded into a score

catalyst_policy.role: urgency/context modifier or independent veto; never a directional root

milestones.measure: Total Portfolio Value only (not AMC-only value, option premium, realized P&L, or cumulative trade proceeds)
milestones.diamond_assumption: Diamond recorded as $15,000 from user shorthand '15$'; PENDING_CONFIRMATION before freezing the goal contract
tier_cannot: encourage additional trades merely because the deadline approaches

strategic_allocation.numerator: marked market value of AMC shares plus AMC option positions
strategic_allocation.delta_equivalent: report later only if trustworthy Greeks become available; never invent now
strategic_allocation.below_floor_behavior: report the gap and evaluate an action; never auto-buy solely to restore the percentage
suspension_conditions: the versioned DNA campaign-break definition is objectively satisfied
the AI records a structured CONFIDENCE_WITHDRAWN decision with evidence
any reduction still passes the normal proposal/revalidation workflow
strategic_allocation.dna_damage_without_user_agreement: position becomes DECISION_REQUIRED and unattended exposure-increasing orders are prohibited
strategic_allocation.user_lost_confidence_without_dna_confirm: record the disagreement and require manual approval for changes
strategic_allocation.upper_bounds_still_required: maximum AMC allocation and option-risk cap must still be defined in the goal contract

data_freshness.underlying_heartbeat_pending: separate smallest task + acceptance test; no Pine change inside P0

option_watchlist.provisional_capacity: all held contracts + no more than 3 entry candidates + 2 roll candidates
required_fields_per_contract: canonical option ticker, underlying, type, strike, expiration
latest causal OHLCV bar timestamp and source
